name: Super A'Can
description: A 16-bit cartridge console from Taiwan's Funtech, released in October 1995 in Taiwan. Built around a Motorola 68000 and custom UMC chips, it was discontinued within months and became a famously rare commercial failure.
curiosities: Funtech reportedly lost more than US$6 million on the console.
Remaining stock was sold off to the United States as scrap parts after production and development equipment was destroyed.
It was discontinued in April 1996, about six months after launch.
unverified: Funtech reportedly lost more than US$6 million on the console.
story: Funtech's Super A'Can was released in Taiwan in 1995.
It was technically ambitious, but it had few games and sold very poorly.
Funtech lost a lot of money on it, and the console is now very rare.
